cohort: A 36-year-old G1P0 woman of Indian origin, diagnosed with Bombay phenotype and complete placenta previa.
finding: Multidisciplinary expertise and strategic planning can lead to successful management and delivery for pregnant women with rare blood types and high-risk conditions, even with limited time for traditional blood procurement strategies.
mod_finding: Urgent cesarean section delivery was performed due to high-risk placenta previa, and intraoperative cell salvage successfully prevented the need for allogeneic transfusion.
